<!-- This is an auto-generated comment by CodeRabbit for review status -->

Approved on the merits — this is the right shape. It reuses `ShouldIncludeReferences` rather than re-deriving the flag, mirrors the empty-but-present convention already established in `trip_handler.go`, and moves the reference-building block verbatim so the `includeReferences=true` path is provably untouched. The test earns its place too: asserting every collection serializes as `[]` rather than `null` is exactly the part that would regress on the wire and wouldn't be caught by a shape-only check.

Heads up on ordering: #1279 just landed on `main` and restructured the same references block in `trip_for_vehicle_handler.go`, so this branch now has conflicts. Please merge `main` in and resolve.

One thing to watch in the resolution: #1279 added a `referencedStopIDs(status, schedule)` helper so that schedule stops end up dereferenceable in `references.stops`. Your `buildTripForVehicleReferences` currently only takes `status`, so the merge needs to thread `schedule` through as well — otherwise resolving the conflict will silently drop #1279's fix.

Once it's mergeable it's good to go; no re-review needed unless the resolution changes behavior.
